laws.rule: Pamplona's San Fermín bando (the city's festival order, in force during the July fiestas) bans glass bottles and glasses in the Plaza Consistorial and Plaza del Castillo during the Chupinazo (the 6 July opening) and on the encierro (bull run) route. Placing or breaking glass in public spaces is sanctioned (art 1.12), and bars must serve in reusable deposit cups (1.13). Being drunk or under the influence of drugs on the encierro route is prohibited (5.13). The bando has no general ban on drinking in the street and states no fine amounts; it cites the civic conduct ordinance and Navarra's laws for them. The copy on the site is titled 2026 but quotes July 2025 dates, so check the current text.
laws.heading: Ayuntamiento de Pamplona, Bando San Fermín 2026, arts 1.12, 1.13, 4.1, 5.13

laws.rule: In the same bando: nobody under 18 may take part in the encierro (5.6), runners must be in position by 07:15 and the run starts at 08:00 (5.2, 5.4), heels, flip-flops and sandals are prohibited on the route (5.13), and flying any aircraft over the encierro area without authorisation is prohibited. Urinating on pavements or in public spaces is sanctioned under the city's civic conduct ordinance (1.12). Caravans may not park on public roads; motorhomes used as lodging may only use the Trinitarios car park or other designated sites (2.5).
laws.heading: Ayuntamiento de Pamplona, Bando San Fermín 2026, arts 2.5, 5.2 to 5.13

events.what: Spanish municipal elections (all town and city councils) and elections to this community's regional parliament, Sunday 23 May 2027: the law sets them for the fourth Sunday of May every four years, unless a regional president with the power to dissolve calls an earlier election.
events.effect: Election day; a day of reflection beforehand. Not yet formally called: the call is issued by decree about 54 days before.

sources.title: Ley Organica 5/1985 del Regimen Electoral General
sources.supports: fourth-Sunday-of-May rule for local and regional elections (read directly); the 2027 date is calculated from it
